# EcoBike

> Cycling app for Nariño, Colombia, on iOS, Android and the web: GPS rides, Eco ruta bike routing with turn-by-turn directions, server-verified points, QR rewards at partner stores, friends and a weekly league. The interface is in Spanish.

The web app works without an account in guest mode ("Explorar sin cuenta"), with sample data. Accounts, points and redemptions go through a serverless API; do not automate sign-ups, rides or redemptions.
